    Structure Refinement: NCAF, WISH¶

    This example demonstrates a Rietveld refinement of Na2Ca3Al2F14 crystal structure using time-of-flight neutron powder diffraction data from WISH at ISIS.

    Two datasets from detector banks 5+6 and 4+7 are used for joint fitting.

    Import Library¶

    In [2]:
    Copied! 
    from easydiffraction import ExperimentFactory
from easydiffraction import Project
from easydiffraction import StructureFactory
from easydiffraction import download_data
    from easydiffraction import ExperimentFactory from easydiffraction import Project from easydiffraction import StructureFactory from easydiffraction import download_data

    Define Structure¶

    This section covers how to add structures and modify their parameters.

    Create Structure¶

    In [3]:
    Copied! 
    structure = StructureFactory.from_scratch(name='ncaf')
    structure = StructureFactory.from_scratch(name='ncaf')

    Set Space Group¶

    In [4]:
    Copied! 
    structure.space_group.name_h_m = 'I 21 3'
structure.space_group.it_coordinate_system_code = '1'
    structure.space_group.name_h_m = 'I 21 3' structure.space_group.it_coordinate_system_code = '1'

    Set Unit Cell¶

    In [5]:
    Copied! 
    structure.cell.length_a = 10.250256
    structure.cell.length_a = 10.250256

    Set Atom Sites¶

    In [6]:
    Copied! 
    structure.atom_sites.create(
    label='Ca',
    type_symbol='Ca',
    fract_x=0.4663,
    fract_y=0.0,
    fract_z=0.25,
    wyckoff_letter='b',
    b_iso=0.92,
)
structure.atom_sites.create(
    label='Al',
    type_symbol='Al',
    fract_x=0.2521,
    fract_y=0.2521,
    fract_z=0.2521,
    wyckoff_letter='a',
    b_iso=0.73,
)
structure.atom_sites.create(
    label='Na',
    type_symbol='Na',
    fract_x=0.0851,
    fract_y=0.0851,
    fract_z=0.0851,
    wyckoff_letter='a',
    b_iso=2.08,
)
structure.atom_sites.create(
    label='F1',
    type_symbol='F',
    fract_x=0.1377,
    fract_y=0.3054,
    fract_z=0.1195,
    wyckoff_letter='c',
    b_iso=0.90,
)
structure.atom_sites.create(
    label='F2',
    type_symbol='F',
    fract_x=0.3625,
    fract_y=0.3633,
    fract_z=0.1867,
    wyckoff_letter='c',
    b_iso=1.37,
)
structure.atom_sites.create(
    label='F3',
    type_symbol='F',
    fract_x=0.4612,
    fract_y=0.4612,
    fract_z=0.4612,
    wyckoff_letter='a',
    b_iso=0.88,
)
    structure.atom_sites.create( label='Ca', type_symbol='Ca', fract_x=0.4663, fract_y=0.0, fract_z=0.25, wyckoff_letter='b', b_iso=0.92, ) structure.atom_sites.create( label='Al', type_symbol='Al', fract_x=0.2521, fract_y=0.2521, fract_z=0.2521, wyckoff_letter='a', b_iso=0.73, ) structure.atom_sites.create( label='Na', type_symbol='Na', fract_x=0.0851, fract_y=0.0851, fract_z=0.0851, wyckoff_letter='a', b_iso=2.08, ) structure.atom_sites.create( label='F1', type_symbol='F', fract_x=0.1377, fract_y=0.3054, fract_z=0.1195, wyckoff_letter='c', b_iso=0.90, ) structure.atom_sites.create( label='F2', type_symbol='F', fract_x=0.3625, fract_y=0.3633, fract_z=0.1867, wyckoff_letter='c', b_iso=1.37, ) structure.atom_sites.create( label='F3', type_symbol='F', fract_x=0.4612, fract_y=0.4612, fract_z=0.4612, wyckoff_letter='a', b_iso=0.88, )

    Define Experiment¶

    This section shows how to add experiments, configure their parameters, and link the structures defined in the previous step.

    Download Measured Data¶

    In [7]:
    Copied! 
    data_path56 = download_data(id=9, destination='data')
    data_path56 = download_data(id=9, destination='data')
    Getting data...

    Data #9: NCAF, WISH (ISIS), Detector banks 5 & 6

    ✅ Data #9 downloaded to 'data/ed-9.xys'
    In [8]:
    Copied! 
    data_path47 = download_data(id=10, destination='data')
    data_path47 = download_data(id=10, destination='data')
    Getting data...

    Data #10: NCAF, WISH (ISIS), Detector banks 4 & 7

    ✅ Data #10 downloaded to 'data/ed-10.xys'

    Create Experiment¶

    In [9]:
    Copied! 
    expt56 = ExperimentFactory.from_data_path(
    name='wish_5_6',
    data_path=data_path56,
    beam_mode='time-of-flight',
)
    expt56 = ExperimentFactory.from_data_path( name='wish_5_6', data_path=data_path56, beam_mode='time-of-flight', )
    In [10]:
    Copied! 
    expt47 = ExperimentFactory.from_data_path(
    name='wish_4_7',
    data_path=data_path47,
    beam_mode='time-of-flight',
)
    expt47 = ExperimentFactory.from_data_path( name='wish_4_7', data_path=data_path47, beam_mode='time-of-flight', )

    Define Project¶

    The project object is used to manage the structure, experiments, and analysis

    Create Project¶

    In [21]:
    Copied! 
    project = Project()
    project = Project()

    Set Plotting Engine¶

    In [22]:
    Copied! 
    # Keep the auto-selected engine. Alternatively, you can uncomment the
# line below to explicitly set the engine to the required one.
# project.plotter.engine = 'plotly'
    # Keep the auto-selected engine. Alternatively, you can uncomment the # line below to explicitly set the engine to the required one. # project.plotter.engine = 'plotly'

    Add Structure¶

    In [23]:
    Copied! 
    project.structures.add(structure)
    project.structures.add(structure)

    Add Experiment¶

    In [24]:
    Copied! 
    project.experiments.add(expt56)
project.experiments.add(expt47)
    project.experiments.add(expt56) project.experiments.add(expt47)
